message: Nicholas Lehmann menioned the "M-I C" comment in his pretty sloppy piece on conspiracy-theory journalism in the most recent New Yorker.  He thought that Ike's comment, which evidently was in one of the last Presidential speeches he gave, didn't in any way represent a change of heart about military hegemony--but has been taken that way by conspiracy-minded liberals ever since.  That might have been one of the only worthwhile things he said in the article.
